tips: Hold your Charm (E) for when Zed uses Death Mark (R)—he always lands directly behind you.
Rush early Armor (Seeker's Armguard or Zhonya's Hourglass).
Punish him with basic attacks when his Shadow (W) is on its ~20s cooldown.
Pop his passive shield with a basic attack before committing your spell combo.
Do not throw Charm directly into his Wind Wall (W).
Bait his dashes away from your minion wave.
